reigns.note: Homeric lord of Thebe under Placus and of the Cilicians of that coast — not of Cilician Tarsus on the Cydnus. Kept as the only Cilician king named in the seven lenses; his residence is `thebe-hypoplakia`. City sky for `tarsus` stays empty: Pausanias 8.28.3 mentions Tarsus only for the cold Cydnus; no lens attests a resident or founder at the city itself (Cilix names the region near the Pyramus; Sandocus founds Celenderis; Amphilochus' oracle is at Mallus).
Raid on Eetion's Thebe under Placus (Homeric Cilicia), not on Tarsus — retained as the Iliad sequel to Eetion's reign row. No `tarsus` residence.
